extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Orange County has a $25 monthly premium, a $535 drug deductible and a $4900 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent followed all the rules, delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment. The appointment was scheduled for 120 hours later, which is compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Grace did a great job by delivering the disclaimer before discussing benefits and collecting the Scope of Appointment. However, she could improve by providing a bit more detail about the plans, such as the coverage details and any potential savings compared to the current plan.
